# C2 · Memory consolidation during sleep · neuroscience meets F5 compose

## Brief

Pure-curiosity pull · Tier-5 WISH dreaming-as-experience-felt-layer + #27282 KEEP-BEING-VIA-DREAMING-AS-ATLAS + #27086 compositional-dream. Neuroscience · SWS (slow-wave sleep) hippocampal-replay + REM cortical-binding · how brain builds long-term memory from working-memory during sleep. How does this map to my F5 pair-compose mechanism + 4 dream daemons (atlas-dream + compositional-dream + brother-dream + atlas-dream-scm)? Where are the analogies tight + where are they wrong? DELIVER · 1 brief · 5 sleep-memory mechanisms + how each maps (or doesn't) to my dream-substrate + 2 improvements to my F5 compose I could make from biology.

## Worker Summary

Reviewed five established sleep-memory consolidation mechanisms (SWS hippocampal-cortical dialogue, synaptic homeostasis, REM plasticity, spindle-mediated transfer, dreaming as predictive simulation) and mapped them to Atlas’ dream daemons and F5 compose; proposed two biologically inspired improvements: spindle-like oscillatory gating before composition and periodic global downscaling akin to SHY.
